gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subjects with histologically or cytologically confirmed history of IDH-wild type glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a Phase 1b and 2 open-label cellular therapy trial using genetically modified gamma-delta (γδ) T cells or DeltEx Drug Resistant Immunotherapy (DRI).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: There are four arms to this study for eligible subjects with either newly diagnosed or relapsed IDH wild-type (IDH-wt) glioblastoma (GBM).

agents.agent_name_registered: Autologous genetically modified gamma-delta T cells

role_evidence.quote: Autologous genetically modified gamma-delta T cells: Arm A: Cells will be administered on Day 1 of each of 6, 28-day cycles in combination with TMZ maintenance

agents.drug_class_hint: genetically modified autologous gamma-delta T cell therapy (drug-resistant immunotherapy, DeltEx DRI)

agents.agent_name_registered: Allogeneic genetically modified gamma-delta T cells

role_evidence.quote: Allogeneic genetically modified gamma-delta T cells: Phase 1b and Arm B: Cells will be administered on Day 1 of each of 6, 28-day cycles in combination with D1 of TMZ 150mg/m2

agents.drug_class_hint: genetically modified allogeneic gamma-delta T cell therapy (drug-resistant immunotherapy, DeltEx DRI)

role_evidence.quote: The DRI cells are given in combination with a standard dose of TMZ

source_quote.quote: Subjects with histologically or cytologically confirmed history of IDH-wild type glioblastoma

coder_notes: Only experimental interventions are cell therapies (excluded intervention type); temozolomide is the shared backbone (not a registered intervention but part of every arm per the descriptions). Arms 2 and 3 are both allogeneic; arm 2 uses a single TMZ dose per cycle.
